name: Stranded! Hair Simulator
source:
Welcome to the Stranded! Hair simulator. Are you having a bad day? A good one? Enter your mood into the simulator and your Hair-um will react accordingly!

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/stranded-hair-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《流落！毛发模拟器》。今天过得糟糕吗？还是很棒？把你的心情输入模拟器，你的毛发精灵就会作出相应反应！

[来源：[url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/stranded-hair-simulator]Itch.io[/url]]
